name: Chirkunda–Kulti District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 63, Chirkunda–Kulti District road, crosses the border between Jharkhand and West Bengal. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — Jharkhand RCD and West Bengal PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
